rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or just above it. Part II rows 14-19 print no row number, so row n takes the nth cell under the ATC/Tax Base/Tax Withheld headers. Schedule 1 rows print no number either: row n (0-based key index) takes the nth printed row under the column headers. Tax Rate cells: the 2-slot comb takes the whole percent and the 1-character box after the printed decimal the tenths (derived:rate{n}_whole / _tenths). Peso comb + 2-slot cents pairs are money_joins. Radios and boxes take xbox_joins. Since #113: item 9 over both lines, Item 13A, the page 2 TIN and the Schedule 1 Treaty Code and ATC print from derived: keys of Form1601FqDraft::to_print_field_map; every other value has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
